hints.title: Pair Cancellation
hints.text: When adjacent characters differ, they neutralize each other and can be eliminated immediately.

hints.title: Stack Simulation
hints.text: Push characters onto a stack; if the incoming character differs from the stack top, pop the top instead of pushing.

hints.title: Final Remainder
hints.text: After processing all characters, the size of the stack represents the irreducible minimum string length.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeatedly searching for adjacent distinct characters via string splicing takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use a stack to resolve adjacent opposing pair cancellations in linear time.
